subtests.name: SpeechRecognition.available resolves with a string value for on-device.
SpeechRecognition.available rejects in a detached context for on-device.
SpeechRecognition.available resolves to 'unavailable' for on-device if 'on-device-speech-recognition' Permission Policy is 'none'.
SpeechRecognition.available should resolve to 'unavailable' for on-device in a cross-origin iframe.
